newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower amid cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower amid cautious trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended lower slightly amid cautious trading by investors in a falling market, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 1.45 points or 0.15 percent to 952.63 on turnover of 42.7 million taka. Losers led gainers by 76 to 50.
"The investors remained cautious as the bear-run continued for a straight fifth session. They are not willing to take risk in a falling market," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
Aftab Automobiles gained 3.5 taka to 343.43, Bangladesh Autocars lost 1.49 to 135.08 and Beximco Fisheries shed 1.18 to 162.76.
